# Inter

The desktop UI font. `kernel/gdi/font_inter.c` contains glyph bitmaps
rasterized from **Inter 4.1** (Regular and SemiBold) by Rasmus Andersson,
licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `LICENSE.txt`).

Source: https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/tag/v4.1
(`extras/ttf/Inter-Regular.ttf`, `extras/ttf/Inter-SemiBold.ttf`).

To regenerate after changing sizes or the character range, see the
instructions at the top of `tools/mkfont.c`.
